svg.text: A planet that always faces Gargantua still rocks a little, and its ocean sloshes
the tidal bulge swings with the rocking
the shallow sea sloshes into a giant wave (Thorne)
125 m/s in ordinary shallow water would need 1,225 m of depth.
The solitary-wave formula is only valid for small waves,
so its closeness here is a coincidence, not a proof.
planet wobble period in the game
wobble grows as the wave nears
